'''''Pulsar Lines''''' was a civilian [[Ferryboat liner]] that was present at [[Calast]], a [[Golan Space Colony 2]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], during a [[Rescue at Bundil II|battle]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. There was a dinner party taking place inside the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
